messages:
maria: starting a region-by-region rollout window — order US -> EU -> APAC. staged slices 20% -> 50% -> 100%. ops-lead will watch capacity and holdpoints.

deploy-bot: deploy kicked: v2.14.3 (sha=d4f2a7e). us=20%, eu=0%, apac=0%. warm pools verified (us-west 12/12). run: deploybot://runs/1767000123

sam: preparing EU fallback pin v2.14.2 (sha a1b2c3). one-command rollback ready.

lee: canary checks added: p50/p95/p99, 5xx rate, OOMs. triggers: p99 > 220ms OR 5xx > 0.5% => hold/rollback.

deploy-bot: us ramped to 50%. snapshot: p50=62ms, p95=118ms, p99=208ms, 5xx=0.09%.

ana: note — background batch jobs earlier caused transient GPU pressure in US; drained 2 nodes pre-rollout. warm pool adjusted.

ops-lead: warm-pool reserve locked to 10% for US. dashboard: https://console.redwood/internal/dashboards/rollout-1767000123

maria: EU is a hard holdpoint. need stable p99 <230ms for 10m before >20% ramp.

deploy-bot: eu ramp to 20%. metrics: p99=252ms (+20% vs baseline), 5xx=0.28%. alert eu-p99-high posted.

sam: investigating eu-gpu-03 GC spikes, restarting agent now.

lee: post-restart p99 ~206ms. recommendation: keep EU at 20% for +15m to avoid flip-flop.

deploy-bot: eu hold extended. rollback pinned: v2.14.2. manual rollback CLI: `deploybot rollback --region eu --version v2.14.2 --reason "p99 spike"`

ops-lead: alerting rules applied: auto-rollback if eu p99 >260ms for 5m OR 5xx >0.5% for 3m -> will page oncall.

maria: APAC warmup scheduled 02:00 UTC, cutover 02:15 local. i'll start warmup 15m prior. any capacity notes?

ana: APAC had a maintenance 02:00-02:10 UTC but non-disruptive. added +8 warm nodes; still watch first 10m.

deploy-bot: status: US stable 50%, EU hold 20% (improving), APAC pending. release notes: https://console.redwood/releases/2.14.3 — batching perf, kernel selection, kvcache eviction fix.

maria: thanks — keep this thread for live updates and tag @ops-lead for immediate rollback. :thumbsup:
